prompt:
Produce a square transparent 4x4 inventory atlas for the TANGMEN martial craft sect. EXACTLY sixteen distinct isolated objects in row-major order. Invisible equal cells with centers at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of both axes. Icons small with at least20% blank transparent margin INSIDE each cell, each silhouette no more than60% cell width or height. Leave broad transparent gutters; no object overlaps another or touches the outside canvas. Transparent alpha. Hand-painted chibi wuxia props, muted indigo and antique copper, ivory paper, subtle teal accent, gouache/watercolor surfaces, fine warm-brown outlines, upper-left lighting, slightly top-down 3/4 view. Ten manuscript icons must use distinctly different bindings, covers, clips, outlines, folded paper/scroll shapes. Any paper showing must be blank or show simple NON-TEXT diagrams only. Strictly NO words, NO writing, NO letters, NO numbers, NO labels, NO grid, NO borders, NO frame, NO glow. Mechanics are stylized fantasy inventory items, not realistic construction diagrams. Exactly preserve the following item silhouettes and order. Do not substitute modern objects. The jacket must be empty, no character.
Row-major content; numbers are ordering instructions, never appear in image:
1. Compact indigo manual with antique-copper corners and three offset throwing-dart silhouettes embossed on the cover.
2. Indigo folded diagram with antique-copper timing ticks, slender dart symbols arranged along separated arcs.
3. Indigo hard book case with antique-copper four-petal clasp and layered mechanism diagrams peeking from the edge.
4. Indigo loose-leaf sheets with antique-copper border and tiny clip, showing glove and narrow needle-case motifs.
5. Palm-sized indigo breathing book with a fine antique-copper clasp, central dot inside a simple circular ring.
6. Indigo ring-bound folio with antique-copper rings and three distinct geometric page tabs.
7. Deep-indigo hardbound book with an antique-copper string-shaped inlay and a narrow leather fastening strap.
8. Narrow indigo folded footwork chart, staggered antique-copper footprints on diagonals and a small four-petal corner mark.
9. Several long indigo slips held by an antique-copper clamp, corridor pillars and curved stepping paths drawn on them.
10. Thick indigo notebook with antique-copper spiral spine, a broken wooden test piece and inspection tabs tucked inside.
11. Half-open rectangular indigo leather case, antique-copper dividers and neatly arranged short leaf-shaped throwing darts.
12. Indigo forearm bracer enclosing folded antique-copper wing-like supports, closed configuration with a prominent circular safety clasp.
13. Indigo short martial jacket with antique-copper fasteners and flat organized tool pouches along the waist.
14. Antique-copper four-petal workshop token, indigo hanging cord and a small square registration notch.
15. Small indigo cloth pouch with antique-copper ring, mist-teal wax seal and a pale powder-cloud emblem.
16. Flat deep-indigo wooden blueprint case partly open, antique-copper four-petal lock and layered ivory diagrams protruding.
visual_review: 已再以 view_image 逐格核對 16 件。金蛇刺改匕首招式書、鎖命針改壓板與針類陷阱圖；三本心法具人體與運氣循環，鳥翔碧空為矩形步法書，暗器心得具鏢針與瞄準圖。暴雨梨花針密孔細針與千機匣弩臂可分辨；其餘八格語義保留。完整剪影互不相接，透明背景，無可讀文字或格線。
revision_prompt:
Edit the provided transparent 4-by-4 TANGMEN martial-arts inventory atlas. Keep exactly SIXTEEN separate inventory objects in identical row-major 4x4 order, painterly dark indigo/ivory/antique-brass styling and perspective. All manuals remain rectangular physical BOOKS or rectangular scrolls; diagrams are flat PRINTED ON THE PAGES OR COVER, never extra floating objects. No readable writing, pseudo-letters, numbers, labels, captions, grid, frames or background. Transparent alpha, complete silhouettes centered inside own cells with broad empty gutters. Every item no wider than 78% of its own cell. Keep first two dart manuals and all unspecified objects recognizable and in place.
Make these exact corrections:
ROW1COL3 (third icon), GOLDEN SNAKE DAGGER technique: the indigo rectangular hardback currently has a large brass flower clasp and abstract diagrams. Replace the large flower with a CLEAR SHORT DAGGER WITH HANDLE AND CROSSGUARD drawn on the cover, accompanied by two curved dagger-stabbing motion paths and a small snake-shaped accent. Visible page diagrams also depict SHORT DAGGER positions. It must be a DAGGER TECHNIQUE BOOK, not a mechanism manual, sword, fan or actual dagger object.
ROW1COL4 (fourth icon), NEEDLE TRAP technique: retain rectangular ivory sheets in an indigo brass-edged book board. REMOVE the GLOVE AND BRACER drawing. Instead print a large simple fictional TRAP pictogram: a small ground pressure plate beside a compact needle device, with dotted warning-radius circle and several slender NEEDLE marks pointing outward. Schematic game symbol only, not realistic construction instructions. It must read as a book about placing a needle trap.
ROW2COL1, basic internal cultivation: rectangular indigo clasped book with a seated meditating human torso diagram and one circular breathing loop. Replace plain dot-and-ring emblem.
ROW2COL2, focused ranged internal cultivation: rectangular indigo ringbound book with a clear front-view HUMAN TORSO MERIDIAN diagram, small bright chest focus point, a smooth circulation loop and tiny feather at corner. Replace blank cover. Dominant body-and-breath motif, not actual crossbow.
ROW2COL3, mechanism internal cultivation: rectangular dark-indigo strapped book with a HUMAN TORSO and circular breath-flow diagram, small gear emblem at bottom corner. Replace abstract ribbon shapes. It must visibly remain a heart-method/internal-cultivation book, not mechanism weapon.
ROW3COL1, aerial footwork manual: replace the fan-shaped bundle of long pillar notes with ONE rectangular open stitched manual, ivory pages and indigo cover. On its pages show clear FOOTPRINTS with a rising then falling dotted arc, and a tiny leaping human silhouette between two low blocks. No folding fan silhouette, no corridor columns. Book about jumping footwork, not an actual airborne figure.
ROW3COL2, hidden-weapon training notebook: retain rectangular indigo notebook with brass spiral binding; REMOVE the BROKEN WOOD SPLINTERS. Instead the cover has small flat illustrations of THROWING DARTS and SLENDER NEEDLES with a dotted aiming path, plus a tiny quill tucked into the spine. It reads as training notes, not a material sample.
ROW3COL4, concealed needle-launcher weapon: retain compact rectangular indigo/brass box, but replace the oversized cannon-like holes with a DENSE FIELD OF VERY TINY PINHOLES on the front, and replace three thick arrow-like projectiles with a few VERY THIN STRAIGHT SILVER NEEDLES without large arrowheads. It must clearly be a delicate needle box, not a gun, organ cannon, crossbow or bracer. Keep completely within its one cell.
KEEP row1col1 dart book, row1col2 rectangular accordion dart chart, row2col4 footprints chart, row3col3 small compact folding-crossbow case, and bottom-row jacket/token/smoke pouch/blueprint box unchanged in design and order. Ensure all sixteen whole objects remain separated with generous transparent margins.
